newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: CSM sees higher in profits in H2 1996/97.
newsitem.headline: CSM sees higher in profits in H2 1996/97.

text.p: Dutch food group CSM said on Thursday it expected net profits in the second half of the current financial year to be higher than those of the same period in 1995/96.

"Based on the satisfactory course of business at the divisions, the contribution of the acquisitions and the positive impact of changes in currency rates, CSM expects that net profits will show an increase in the second half as well," CSM said in a statement.
In February, CSM said it expected net profits to show an increase over the whole of the 1996/97 financial year.
The company earlier reported a net profit of 101.1 million guilders over the first 1996/97 half ended March 97, up from 93.5 million guilders during the year-earlier period.
Analysts' forecasts had ranged from 100 million to 106 million guilders.
